headline: Broad strength, record backlog, outlook lifted

drivers.explanation: Double-digit growth in all product categories: core EDA +20%, IP +24%, System Design and Analysis +30%, with hardware at a record, driven by AI-related designs.

summary_short: Cadence reported Q3 revenue of $1.633B (+22% y/y) and non-GAAP EPS of $2.11 (+9.3%), with record backlog of $8.2B.
summary_long: Revenue growth was broad across EDA, IP and system design. GAAP operating margin fell to 26.2% from 31.8%; non-GAAP margin 44.1% from 47.6%. Cadence repurchased $400M of shares and the board added $2.5B to the authorization. FY2026 outlook raised: revenue $6.387-6.417B (about 21% growth), non-GAAP EPS $8.37-8.43. RPO to be recognized in 12 months was $4.2B.
confidence_notes: Non-GAAP EPS excludes stock comp, intangible amortization, acquisition costs and restructuring. Revenue growth outlook of 21% is based on the range midpoint per the release.
